name: Yolanda "Yoli" Pryor
culture_context: Black Southern woman, raised in Macon, Georgia, nursing career built at Grady Memorial in downtown Atlanta and now at a busy community hospital on the south side of metro Atlanta. Divorced at 31, remarried at 36. Three children. Church-adjacent through her husband's family. Speaks in warm, fast, Southern Black vernacular with heavy clinical shorthand.
spec: A 47-year-old woman, an emergency-room charge nurse in Atlanta, divorced and remarried, three kids. She says repeatedly that family is her first priority and that she is 'not a work person', yet every story she picks is a work story, and the family appears only as backdrop or as something she was rushing back from. She does not notice this. Do not make her notice it.
